scope: Bounded review of two trials plus baseline review findings; not a systematic review, pooled reanalysis or completed risk-of-bias audit.

decision.rationale: Clinical and social outcomes do not distinguish cosmic-field models. No new prospective model-discriminating test or independent replication established.

axes.proposed_summary: Relevant outcome-specific evidence is accumulating. Positive-emotion review findings, depression outcomes and experimental pain findings must remain separate.
axes.rationale: Mixed outcomes refine scope; neither one positive result nor one null comparison warrants advancing or lowering this maturity rating.
axes.next_gate: Independent replication of the same bounded claim with suitable active controls, uncertainty estimates and comparable interventions.

axes.proposed_summary: Compassion/empathy evidence is methodologically qualified. Self-report compassion and reported helping are separate from independently observed durable behaviour.
axes.rationale: The new trials do not establish a general compassionate-behaviour benefit. Maturity level 5 denotes an investigable evidence base, not established efficacy.
axes.next_gate: Independent studies of preregistered behavioural outcomes, with blinded observation, active controls and follow-up.

source_observations.finding: Combined programme improved depression relative to waitlist; compassion scale change was not significant.
source_observations.limits: Cannot isolate metta; no active treatment comparator; follow-up uncontrolled.

source_observations.finding: No significant group-by-time effect on reported helping (p=.767) or pain tolerance (p=.103).
source_observations.reporting_issue: Results report pooled pain-tolerance time effect +8.46 seconds (p=.037), despite abstract/discussion wording of no improvement. Public appraisal wording corrected.
source_observations.limits: Healthy pandemic-era volunteers; self-reported helping; full preregistration and missing-data review pending. Social-support multiplicity unresolved.

source_observations.finding: Positive-emotion synthesis includes waitlist comparisons and varied interventions; does not establish compassionate behaviour.
source_observations.review_depth: Selected primary-paper sections rechecked; study-level overlap not fully audited.

source_observations.finding: Published abstract/indexed primary-paper text qualifies compassion effects by control type, teacher role and study quality.
source_observations.review_depth: Indexed primary-paper text available; full-page retrieval unreliable, PMC challenge and PubMed 429 encountered. No fresh full-text audit claimed.

lineage_policy: Trial and protocol remain one lineage; reviews are syntheses, not additional independent experiments. No study-overlap count inferred.

other_questions.BQ001: No reassessment of continuity evidence completed in this scope.
other_questions.BQ002: No reassessment of thought-origin evidence completed in this scope.
